principle: A noun subject independently analyzed as plural requires a third-person-plural finite verb in the reviewed statement construction.
source_evidence: Qaamuuska Af-Soomaaliga (Puglielli & Mansuur, 2012) — CUN paradigm: cuneen is 3pl past and cunayaan is 3pl ongoing; cunay/cunayaa are singular-compatible forms
Qaamuuska Af-Soomaaliga (Puglielli & Mansuur, 2012) — noun paradigms preserve plural number separately from grammatical gender
note: Execution requires independent plural evidence for the noun and an exact reviewed finite-verb analysis. Unknown verbs stay unjudged; no suffix-only verb guessing.
Plural grammatical gender does not turn a plural subject into singular agreement. Third-person plural verb person is checked separately from noun gender and from wuu/way clitic selection.
